newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Initial Public Offerings - May 12.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Initial Public Offerings - May 12.

text.p: Following is a list of expected initial public share offerings (IPOs) in Singapore.
* Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) approval granted
COMPANY SHRS CURRENCY/ EXPECTED OPEN/ LEAD
(MLN) PRICE LIST DATE
Amara Holdings -- -- -- --
(Amara Holdings Ltd is a hotel company.)
Benefun -- -- May --
(Fashion products retailer Befun International Holdings Ltd, a subsidiary of Singapore's Heshe Holdings, is expected to seek a primary listing in Hong Kong and a secondary listing in Singapore.)
GES Singapore -- S$ -- --
(GES Singapore Pte Ltd makes personal computers.)
Huan Hsin -- US$ -- OCBC
(Taiwan telephone cord and accessories group Huan Hsin Holdings is expected to seek a listing on the main board of the SES, with part of the proceeds used to finance business expansion.)
Inchcape -- S$ -- --
(Trading group Inchcape Berhad said it wants to list its marketing services group on the main board of the SES)
*Poh Lian 54 S$0.42 May 15 UOB

(Integrated access equipment supplier Poh Lian Holdings will list on the SES main board. It said the net proceeds of about S$21 million would support efforts to expand selectively in high growth economies such as Malaysia and China.)
Raffles Hldngs -- S$ H2 1997 --
(Raffles Holdings is the hotel arm of DBS Land and manages Singapore's Raffles Hotel.)
Sinochem -- -- -- UOB

(Sinochem Asia Holdings is an arm of the Chinese state oil and commodities company Sinochem. The company has applied to the SES for a listing, but recently said it has suspended the listing plan indefinitely.)
Transtech Elec -- S$ Q3 1997 --
(Contract manufacturer Transtech Electronics Pte Ltd hopes to raise about S$18 million from an IPO expected around August. It will seek an SES mainboard listing.)
*Tye Soon Ltd 60 S$0.31 May 19 Stan Chart
(Vehicle parts distributor Tye Soon Pte Ltd said net proceeds of about S$18.7 million would be used to expand operations in Malaysia, build additional space in Singapore, and repay loans.)
Winbox Holdings -- -- -- OCBC
(Winbox Holdings Pte Ltd carries out the packaging business of Hong Kong-based Goodwill Investment (Holdings) Ltd and has applied to list on the foreign board of the SES).
Wireless Com -- -- -- --

(Mobile phone operator Wireless Communications Service, 45 percent owned by Thailand-based Total Access Communication, is reportedly considering a listing on the foreign board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.)
